hints.title: Zero Step Boundary
hints.text: If k == 0, no numbers can change, so nums1 and nums2 must be identical.

hints.title: Multiple of k Difference
hints.text: Every difference nums1[i] - nums2[i] must be an exact multiple of k.

hints.title: Balance of Increments and Decrements
hints.text: Total increments of k must equal total decrements of k, and each valid operation performs one increment and one decrement simultaneously.

hints.title: Balanced Operation Counting Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: No index pairing simulation is needed because positive and negative deviations can always be matched greedily.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Verifies that diff % k == 0 and confirms total positive steps equal total negative steps.
